body.p: Claims 1-15 have been examined. Claims 1-10 and 12-14 are rejected. Claims 11 and 15 are objected to and indicated as containing allowable subject matter.
The title is objected to as not being descriptive. In response, the Applicant has amended the title to be more descriptive.
The disclosure is objected to because the acronym "SLOOP" is not defined. In response, the Applicant has provided the definition of "SLOOP," which is well known.

Claims 1-7, 10, 12, and 14 are rejected under 35 USC 101 as being directed to an Abstract Idea without significantly more. Also, claims 1-10 and 12-14 are rejected under 35 USC 103 as being unpatentable over Mazurkewitz et al. (US 2018/0025466; hereinafter
"Mazurkewitz") in view of Leng et al. (US 2020/0214619; hereinafter "Leng")

The Applicant does not concede the validity of these rejections. Nevertheless, in order to advance prosecution, the Applicant has placed the application into condition for allowance by amending independent claim 1 to include the features of allowable dependent claim 11 and has amended independent claim 14 to include the features of allowable dependent claim 15. Reconsideration and withdrawal of these rejections are therefore respectfully requested.
The Applicant believes the pending application is in condition for allowance.

The Director is hereby authorized to charge any additional fees that may be required with respect to this communication or credit any overpayment to Deposit Account No. 19-0733 under Order No. 009528.00400\US.
